hypotheses.statement: Career coaches will pay $149/mo for white-label, O*NET-grounded automation defense reports because ChatGPT lacks data credibility and no coaching platform offers automation-specific white-label reports.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: B2C market is saturated, but this hypothesis is B2B. Coach WTP validated at $149/mo by Intry and CoachStackHub.

hypotheses.statement: O*NET 30.3 data grounding is a defensible differentiator that career coaches value because it provides government-source credibility that ChatGPT and generic AI tools cannot replicate.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: AIJobImpactCalculator also uses O*NET, but is B2C free, not B2B white-label.

hypotheses.statement: Bridge role pathfinding (A* algorithm via skill overlap) is a unique capability that no competitor offers, and coaches will use it to show clients actionable transition paths.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: Kairo offers similar adjacent role paths, but is B2C free beta.

hypotheses.statement: The 50+ pre-built SEO occupation pages at /automation-risk/:slug will drive organic traffic that converts to free-tier signups, which funnel to coach outreach via upgrade prompts.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: 12+ free competitors have SEO head start. WillRobotsTakeMyJob has 8+ years of domain authority.
